name: TGBS _burnPool catch-up burns pair balance
summary: TGBS burned 0.3% of its pair's TGBS on each transfer while _burnBlock lagged the block number, advancing it only 1,200 blocks per burn. After the owner set _burnBlock to 1, the attacker flash-borrowed WBNB, bought TGBS and made 1,600 one-wei self-transfers, each burning pair TGBS and syncing, then sold back into the inflated price.
notes: Reset is the owner's setBurnBlock(1) about an hour before the anchor (after setBurnBlock(0) at block 36708087). Before that _burnBlock tracked the block number, so a transfer could trigger at most one 0.3% burn; set to 1, it let one transaction trigger thousands. Deployment alone was not exploitable.
Campaign: copycat 0xd070490b repeated the 1,601-burn loop 72 blocks later. Later txs by the stake-fee address 0x1eab3b72 and 0xec819380 triggered burns but drew no WBNB and are excluded.
Loss is gross WBNB pair depletion in both txs at DefiLlama BNB $406.04; TGBS burned from the pair is not counted separately.
